children: Daktronics, Inc. (NASDAQ:DAKT) reiterated fiscal 2028 targets — 7–10% revenue CAGR, 10–12% operating margin and 17–20% ROIC — as it amended a JPMorgan-led credit deal to ease patent transfers for facility flexibility and boosted CEO Ramesh Jayaraman’s pay and 2027 cash incentive.
Daktronics, Inc. Targets Persisted Revenue CAGR
: Daktronics (DAKT) kept fiscal 2028 targets: 7–10% revenue CAGR, 10–12% operating margin, 17–20% ROIC, citing a strong sales pipeline and steady demand in key markets.
Daktronics, Inc. Amends JPMorgan Credit Deal

: Daktronics (DAKT) amended its credit deal with JPMorgan and lenders, effective Sept 1, 2026, allowing transfer of certain non-core patents below 75% of fair market value to add facility flexibility.
Daktronics, Inc. Raises CEO Base Salary
: Daktronics (DAKT) raised CEO Ramesh Jayaraman’s base salary to $600,000 effective Sept 13, 2026, and set the fiscal 2027 cash incentive target at 100% of base salary.
